title: Normalize decision support records at construction boundaries
description:
The decision support leaf migration left the live decision builders producing raw mapping payloads while loaded exports produce `Choice`, `MultiAmountItem`, and `PilotContext` dataclasses. As a result, renderer and helper code now carries compatibility unions like `dict | PilotContext` / `DecisionSupportRecordLike` and has to branch on both shapes.

Clean this up at the source: introduce one canonical construction path for decision support records in `puppeteer/src/puppeteer/pilot.py` and `scripts/export_game.py`, so downstream code receives typed leaf records instead of ad hoc dicts. The follow-up should remove the dict-or-dataclass unions from `puppeteer/src/puppeteer/decision_renderer.py` and any similar helper signatures that only exist because the builders are still untyped.
